definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minsurf.parametric, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: R. Schoen / Lopez & Ros (1991) on the Lopez-Ros deformation; H. F. Scherk (1835) for the base Scherk surface; the decorated-Enneper symmetrization follows M. Weber's repository, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (Enneper with n Catenoids).

cross_checked.source: minimalsurfaces.blog (minsurf ch058) + K. Sato, Tohoku Math. J. 48 (1996) 229-246; M. Weber, M. Wolf; E. Thayer, Experiment. Math. 4 (1995)
cross_checked.detail: Published family law for the drive stage: 'The Chen-Gackstatter surface of genus g has finite total curvature -4pi(g+1), the largest possible value for its genus', with 'one Enneper end of winding number 3' -- per-specimen total curvature must follow -4pi(g+1).
